subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should this PR ship an install-only `--agent` plugin surface now, or should per-agent plugin installation wait until uninstall/update/runtime/security semantics are implemented together?
rationale: The branch adds a public CLI flag and persisted config/index shape while the related issue is still marked as needing maintainer product and security review, and runtime activation remains global by the PR's own non-goal statement.

options.title: Require full lifecycle before merge
options.body: Fix install, uninstall, update, registry lookup, validation, docs, and security semantics in this PR before accepting the new public flag.

options.title: Accept staged install-only behavior
options.body: Maintainers explicitly accept that `--agent` only changes the install root and record metadata while runtime activation remains global for now.

options.title: Pause for canonical design
options.body: Keep this implementation out of main until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97749 has an approved per-agent plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Require full lifecycle before merge
recommendation.body: Fix install, uninstall, update, registry lookup, validation, docs, and security semantics in this PR before accepting the new public flag.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING identifies Peter as the product decision owner, and this PR needs product acceptance for a new public plugin lifecycle surface.
